{{Quote|They're small-time gunrunners out of Elkkasinn and Sunin. Mostly K'rrandin, but with some humans thrown into the mix.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], about the [[Sendavé Shared Interest Collective]]''|<ref name="HAT" />}}
'''Sunin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Many gunrunners of the [[Sendavé Shared Interest Collective]] were from [[Elkkasinn]] and Sunin.<ref name="HAT" />
